name: log
comment: Sig: r = log(...). Element-wise libm-backed primitive (SIMD via Highway hn::Log). Negative scalar promotes to complex: log(-1)==0+pi*i. ARRAY promotion (fixed 2026-06-05): any negative element promotes the WHOLE array — log([-1 4])=[0+pi*i 1.3863+0i] (previously the negative became real NaN). std::log's branch matches MATLAB. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b.
